entry.content: ... that the lyrics in Conan Gray's song "People Watching" were based on things he heard while eavesdropping on couples?

entry.content: ... that Lydie Pongault was appointed to the Congolese government to fill the roles of two other ministers?

entry.title: gray stonecrop (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the gray stonecrop was little known in the 1970s but became so popular by the 1990s that demand exceeded supply?

entry.title: Johann Jacob Ferber (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that using samples provided by Johann Jacob Ferber, it was demonstrated that mosaics at Pompeii were made with glass paste, not stone?

entry.title: resigned in protest (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that seven U.S. prosecutors resigned in protest over the Eric Adams corruption case?

entry.title: Ruothild (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Abbess Ruothild wrapped the body of Saint Fara in a silk covered with bare-breasted Amazons?

entry.title: Elora's Dad (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Ethan Hawke and Devery Jacobs smoked CBD while filming the Reservation Dogs episode "Elora's Dad"?

entry.title: his translation of the Odyssey (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that when someone accused George Chapman of basing his translation of the Odyssey on a Latin translation, he called them an "envious Windfucker" in the preface?
